title: [Bug 642248] Header/Footer Theme Assignment: persist selected layout (missing Rec.Modify)
summary: A data-persistence bug on the Header/Footer Theme Assignment page is fixed by adding a missing Rec.Modify() call, ensuring selected header and theme parts are saved to the database. A minor caption casing fix is also applied to the Report Layouts page.
key_points: Added Rec.Modify() calls in lookup handlers for header and theme part assignments
Selections on the Header/Footer Theme Assignment page now persist after navigation
Caption text corrected from 'Composite Layout' to 'Composite layout' on Report Layouts page
No schema or permission changes required
Low-risk fix with manual verification testing
